the 36/8 fractional slot winding configuration has the best torque quality and torque ripple among all six motor models.
The torque quality of the fractional-slot IPMSMs is better than that of the integer-slot machines.

the 36/8 fractional slot winding is the best choice for the IPMSMs with single V-shape and double V-shape magnet configurations in terms of torque quality at both the low-speed and high-speed points, but it is not a good choice for the IPMMS with the delta-shape magnet configuration.

the optimization of slot-pole combination for interior permanent magnet machines with different magnet configurations.

the 36/8 IPMSMs with the delta-shape magnet have the highest torque density among all six motor models.

, for the 36/8 IPMSMs with the same magnet material and same magnet thickness, the double V-shape magnets have the best torque performance at low-speed point and the delta-shaped magnets have the best performance at high-speed point.

, the delta-shape rotor is a good choice for the IPMSMs with integer-slot winding configuration, while the 36/8 fractional slot winding configuration with the double V-shape rotor is better for IPMSMs with fractional slot winding configuration.

36/8 IPMSM with delta-shape magnets has a better torque quality at both the low- and high- speed points, and it is the preferred choice for the IPMSM.

the slot/pole number combination is the most crucial factor for the torque quality of IPMSMs with different magnet toplogies.
